title: T13: mirror watch answers and keep access_level admin-set
head: codex/t13-profile-decisions
body:
## What
Makes the approved onboarding decisions (#31, #38) concrete:
- Yes/No "Can I watch this page?" answers mirror into `profile.yaml.watch_answers` through `ProfileStore`. The drawer's existing `watch_answers.yaml` stays as the store used before a profile exists; reads merge both.
- Not now is never saved, so the page is asked again next visit.
- Onboarding never asks for or accepts `access_level`. `load_questions` rejects a question for it; new profiles default to `member`; an existing value such as `admin` survives every run.
- Still only the three fixed YAML formats.

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)
- `uv run --no-sync pytest -q` → 50 passed
- `uv run --no-sync ruff check .` → All checks passed
- `uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .` → 31 files already formatted
- `uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src` → no issues in 9 files (native and `--platform win32`)
- `git diff --check` → clean

## Still pending (human)
The user-zero Rig walkthrough and profile review.
